query: INSERT INTO tabac_terroir_links (tabac_id, terroir_id, soil_ph, soil_type, nitrogen_level, potassium_level, climate_notes, cultivation_notes) SELECT t.id, te.id, 5.8, 'Alluvial riche en matiere organique', 'Modere', 'Eleve', 'Climat subtropical humide Cfa - Precipitations 1500mm/an', 'Fermentation traditionnelle en presse pendant 12 mois' FROM tabacs t, terroirs te WHERE t.name LIKE '%Perique%' AND te.name = 'Saint James Parish';
